shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && rg -n \"class ToolRegistry|register\\(|execute\\(\" src/orchestration/tools src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts && cat package.json && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n \"validated by|specs/|test\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts src/**/*.test.ts | head -80; rg -n 'ajv' package-lock.json node_modules/ajv/package.json 2>/dev/null | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"spec:|specs/.*#|validated by\" src test . 2>/dev/null | head -120; sed -n '1,150p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,220p' jest.config.js 2>/dev/null || true; git log -5 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): validate required tool input" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
